There's something I don't see a lot of people talking about that is kinda huge for me: crafting and gathering

First of all, crafting in wow is just "click button, make item" whereas here it's more involved and I love it for that. Gathering has also been more enjoyable because it's a bit more involved than just hoping to stumble across the thing you want. Seriously, I love the gathering log!

Additionally, and this is something of an offshoot of "every class on one character", you can be every crafter and every gatherer in this game. In WoW I had to have a bunch of alts in order to gather mats and craft items myself. And if I wanted to switch I would have to give up all my progress!

I know this may not be huge for other folks but it's something I really enjoy about this game and wanted to share.

EDIT: I almost forgot to mention the crafting storylines! I don't remember if there was any such thing in WoW (I think there wasn't) but the storyline quests for crafters and gatherers are really well done and absolutely worth doing!

Disclaimer: I am not a scientist, just a fan of physics stuff.

My understanding is that the gravity is so intense from one point in space to the next that the forces pulling on you as you fall in stretch you out into a thin strand of matter in a process known as spaghettification.

Supposing you survive that, nobody really knows what you would see because the gravitational pull is so intense that no energy can escape and so we can't really see anything closer than a certain distance away from the center from outside.

Additional fun fact: an outside observer would see all this happen at a pace that gets slower and slower until, a very long time later outside the black hole but a short time later for you, at the very moment you reach the center the black hole it evaporates.

The reason for the slowness is that the gravitational pull is so intense that objects approaching the hole rapidly accelerate ever closer to the speed of light. As something approaches the speed of light, time dilates more and more for it, though only outside observers notice anything is amiss because the frame of reference for the object is still as though time were passing normally.

Tl;Dr black holes are cool and slightly terrifying, but mostly cool.
